newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish KFX share index seen hitting new peak.
newsitem.headline: Danish KFX share index seen hitting new peak.

text.p: Danish shares opened higher on Wednesday, buoyed by the overnight Dow rise and the strong dollar and dealers saw the top-20 KFX index hitting new record heights for the seventh time this month.
"The KFX index should rise at least one percent today to yet another all-time closing high with interest centred on financial and export industry paper," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.33 point to 179.34 at 0720 GMT, having closed 0.76 point higher on Tuesday.
